name: MNM
title: Rate matrix on triplets/codons that includes multi-nucleotide mutations
description:
A rate matrix on triplets or codons that includes multinucleotide mutations.
The rates of single-nucleotide mutations are given by the nucleotide rate matrix.  The rates of 2- and 3-nucleotide mutations are proportional to the frequencies of the target nucleotides and do not distinguish between transitions and transversions.
The v2 and v3 parameters control the equilibrium event rates of 2- and 3-nucleotide mutations relative to the event rate of single-nucleotide mutations.  The fraction of mutations that are 2-nucleotide mutations is:
   v2/(1+v2+v3)
Since a 2-nucleotide mutation changes two nucleotides, the fraction of changed nucleotides attributable to 2-nucleotide mutations is:
   2*v2/(1+2*v2+3*v3)
